MRI Information
MR Conditional (3 Tesla or less): spatial field gradient ≤ 3000 G/cm (30 T/m); B1+RMS of 2 µT or less; for MR scanners that do not report B1+rms, Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.4 W/kg; Maximum Head SAR 1 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode; No more than 10 minutes of active scan time per session; A cooling period of 10 minutes is required between scans; Head Transmit/Receive Coil ONLY.
Device configuration during MRI: Stimulation OFF.
Image artifact: up to 2 mm.
Testing used a maximum gradient amplitude of 40 mT/m.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
